serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: What, you don’t remember anything, kid? 
You: Remember what? The last thing I remember is smoking that fish joint you gave me…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Huh. {{wi}}It’s rare, but sometimes people don’t remember what happened on that plane. It usually happens when you disrespect someone there, but I guess it’s pointless asking about it since you wouldn’t remember it anyway.
You: What the hell are you talking about?
You: That was the worst drug experience I ever had, I can still feel the cold sweat on my back. What was the point of all of it?! 
#mrsfisher.Face.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Stop complaining, kid, and grab your rod!{{punch}}
You: Ok…
Jeez, she doesn’t need to scream all of a sudden; I’m still dazed…
Mrs. Fisher: Cast your rod. Did you notice any difference?
You: Yeah! I had never cast this far before, even though my hands are still trembling! What’s going on?
#mrsfisher.Eyes.NormalClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: That’s the effect of my guidance. 
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Your physique and technique aren’t half bad, so there had to be another reason you stopped improving. That “fish joint,” as you call it, helped with that. 
You: I have no idea how that is supposed to work, but the effects are undeniable…
Mrs. Fisher: Come back later for another session.
You: Another session?! I don’t think I want to try smoking that again, one puff and I was gone for like a few hours!
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry 
Mrs. Fisher: Complaining again? You are seriously pissing me off today. 
Mrs. Fisher: Do you really think one session would fix your issues? Don’t make me laugh, kid.
Mrs. Fisher: I thought you wanted to improve, I guess I was wrong. 
You: …
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Eh… Forget it, kid. I guess that type of stuff just isn’t for everyone. Sorry for spooking you out.
You: No problem.
Mrs. Fisher: Listen, I’m sure that in time you will get better on your own.
You: Give me some time, I will think about it.
Mrs. Fisher: You do you.
